unsupported_exact_values.why_unrecoverable: Figure 2B bars show approximate IC50 values for Raji, K562, Eca109, HeLa, MCF-7, and MDA-MB-231, but the local XML/PDF text does not print exact numeric values. Only DU145 IC50 is text-reported exactly.
unsupported_exact_values.impact: Nonblocking caution; exact values were not fabricated. Primary-source qualitative claim and exact DU145 IC50 are preserved.
